list: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list, as mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: What: the platinum — it unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. How: work the six stages of this guide's roadmap in order, clearing the missable watch list first, then the long grinds (250 stunts, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles) while the story is still open. Missable: no — it cannot be missed, but a missed trophy anywhere else blocks it, so guard the watch list. Tip: the points counter above shows 15 per bronze, 30 per silver, 90 per gold and 300 for this platinum.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: What: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first story beat of the game. How: play the story from the start and follow the mission prompts; it unlocks when the mission completes, with no side requirement. Missable: no — story missions can be replayed, so an opening-mission trophy is safe. Tip: use this first hour to learn the controls and the map of Leonida before the checklist gets long.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: What: reach the end of Chapter 1. How: play every Chapter 1 story mission in order until the chapter closes; the trophy pops at the chapter-complete beat. Missable: no — chapters are linear story progress and nothing here is optional. Tip: between missions, knock out nearby collectibles (meditation spots, WAiNK) so the late-game grind shrinks.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: What: reach the end of Chapter 2. How: keep playing the story missions in order; the chapter trophy unlocks when the last Chapter 2 mission wraps. Missable: no — chapter completions are unmissable story progress. Tip: Chapter 2 opens up more of Leonida, so start the vehicle-discovery and WAiNK habits now rather than saving all 100 for the end.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: What: reach the end of Chapter 3. How: play the Chapter 3 missions through to the chapter's closing beat. Missable: no — like every chapter trophy, it follows automatically from finishing the story. Tip: by now the stranger strands should be appearing — pick them up as you meet each stranger instead of leaving all eight for the endgame.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: What: reach the end of Chapter 4. How: finish the Chapter 4 mission chain; the trophy lands at the chapter close. Missable: no — chapter trophies are automatic story progress. Tip: before the finale, sweep the missable watch list (choices, the VCIA departure, the showroom smash) — the endgame is the last safe window for several of them.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: What: finish the final story mission — the gold that caps the campaign. How: play through every chapter to the finale and complete the last mission; it unlocks at the credits beat. Missable: no — the final mission itself is unmissable, but do the missable watch list BEFORE it, since some one-off moments may close with the story. Tip: after the finale, free roam is your cleanup phase: collectibles, races, stunts and the 100% push toward A Long Road.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: What: finish the story mission Breakfast Run. How: follow the mission when it appears in the story flow and see it through to its end. Missable: no — named story missions unlock in order and can be replayed. Tip: named-mission trophies like this one are the roadmap's mile markers — tick them off as the story hands them to you.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: What: finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. How: play the mission when the story offers it and complete its objectives. Missable: no — it is a scripted story mission, so it comes to you in order. Tip: heist missions are good practice for the crime trophies later (vaults, armored trucks) — learn the escape routes here.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: What: finish the story mission Child's Play. How: take the mission when it appears and complete it. Missable: no — story missions arrive in sequence and replay from the mission menu. Tip: keep an eye on which stranger strands are open alongside the story — finishing them early keeps stage 3 of the roadmap short.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: What: finish the story mission Headliners. How: play it when the story reaches it and complete its objectives. Missable: no — a named story mission, unmissable in sequence. Tip: if a mission feels hard, remember the roadmap — the grind trophies (stunts, shooting range, races) sharpen the same skills these missions test.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: What: finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. How: complete the mission when the story serves it up. Missable: no for this trophy itself — but the VCIA area also holds the likely-missable Catch Me If You Can, so make the unscheduled departure while you are here, before the mission window closes. Tip: treat every VCIA visit as a two-trophy stop.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: What: finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. How: play the mission through when it arrives in the story order. Missable: no — a scripted mission trophy. Tip: this is the last named-mission trophy before the finale stretch, so use the pause after it to clear partner feats and the moments sweep in stage 5.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: What: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist — the gold that sits just under the platinum. How: clear every completion category the game tracks (story, collectibles, activities and the rest); the game's own completion screen shows what is left. Missable: no — it is a grind, not a window, but it shares its shopping list with the collectible and activity trophies, so chase them together. Tip: this is the last trophy before the platinum pops — when it unlocks, Vice Got a Price! follows at once.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: What: complete 250 stunts — the game's biggest counted grind. How: use stunt jumps, ramps and air time across Leonida; each completed stunt adds to the count, so fold stunting into every drive instead of treating it as a separate chore. Missable: no — the count only grows, and free roam after the story is the best place to farm it. Tip: pair this with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles) — new vehicles mean new stunt runs.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: What: sample every activity type at least once — a sampler, not a mastery test. How: visit each activity the game offers (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone races and the rest) and complete one session of each; the trophy pops when the last type is tried. Missable: no — activities stay open in free roam. Tip: do this early in stage 4; it doubles as a tour of every grind the roadmap still owes you.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: What: gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count PlayStation tracks for this trophy. How: work through the range's challenge list one by one, learning each weapon's recoil and timing; gold needs clean, fast runs, so repeat a challenge until the medal flips. Missable: no — the range is open whenever you want it. Tip: this is the hardest silver in the set, so spread it across sessions and warm up on the easier challenges first.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: What: win a Top Fun drone race at every race location. How: find each drone-race spot on the map, enter, and win; the trophy needs a win everywhere, not just one venue. Missable: no — drone races repeat. Tip: learn one clean racing line per location and reuse it; crashing once costs the win, so fly the line, not the shortcut.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: What: win 20 different races — variety matters, not repeats of one favourite. How: enter races across Leonida (street, off-road, whatever the map offers) and win 20 distinct ones; replaying a won race adds nothing. Missable: no — races are repeatable free-roam activities. Tip: track which races you have won in the notes field here, so you never waste a run re-winning one.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: What: beat Cal head-to-head in a fishing challenge. How: find Cal's fishing challenge, take it on, and out-fish him — steady reeling beats frantic reeling when the line is under tension. Missable: no — fishing challenges can be retried. Tip: do this in the same session as your other fishing visits; the Gone Fishing opening already taught you the basics.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: What: finish one arcade game, start to end. How: step into an arcade, pick a cabinet, and play it through to its end screen. Missable: no — arcades stay open in free roam. Tip: pick the shortest cabinet first; the trophy only asks for one completion, so save high-score chasing for after it pops.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_reason: Strand finale — finish Andy's strand before the endgame closes it off.
trophies.guide: What: finish Andy's final stranger mission. How: meet Andy, work through his strand of missions in order, and complete the last one. Missable: watch — stranger strands can close as the story ends, so finish Andy's strand during stage 3, not after the finale. Tip: strands unlock as you explore, so check the map for stranger icons between story missions.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_reason: Strand finale — finish Kenton's strand before the endgame closes it off.
trophies.guide: What: finish Kenton's final stranger mission. How: follow Kenton's strand through its missions to the last one. Missable: watch — like every stranger finale, it belongs in stage 3, before the story's endgame. Tip: the name hints at boats, so expect water — bring a fast boat mindset, not a car one.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_reason: Strand finale — finish Billy's strand before the endgame closes it off.
trophies.guide: What: finish Billy's final stranger mission. How: work Billy's strand to its last mission and complete it. Missable: watch — stranger strands are the classic missable-adjacent content in this series, so clear them in stage 3. Tip: the Lone Rider name suggests solo riding — keep a good bike handy for this strand.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs all 8 strands — finish them before the endgame closes any off.
trophies.guide: What: complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — the silver that proves you met the state's oddballs. How: find and finish eight strangers' strands end to end (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and three more). Missable: watch — the count needs eight strands done, so start early and finish before the finale. Tip: this is the stage-3 hub trophy — when it pops, the five stranger finales should be close behind.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_reason: Strand finale — finish Randy's strand before the endgame closes it off.
trophies.guide: What: finish Randy's final stranger mission. How: take Randy's strand through to its last mission. Missable: watch — finish in stage 3 alongside the other stranger finales. Tip: supply-and-demand work usually means moving goods — keep a sturdy vehicle ready rather than a fast fragile one.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_reason: Strand finale — finish Tyrone's strand before the endgame closes it off.
trophies.guide: What: finish Tyrone's final stranger mission. How: complete Tyrone's strand to its last mission. Missable: watch — the last of the five named stranger finales; clear all five before the endgame. Tip: when this pops, stage 3 is nearly done — only the 8-strand silver should remain.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: What: meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. How: find each spot (quiet scenic places across the state), stop, and meditate; the trophy pops at the last one. Missable: no — spots stay where they are in free roam. Tip: meditation spots are a natural road-trip checklist — pair them with the WAiNK and vehicle routes so one drive covers three trophies.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: What: hunt down one unique animal for Bret. How: pick up Bret's hunt, track the animal it points to, and take it down — unique animals do not respawn as ordinary wildlife, so follow the hunt's clues rather than wandering. Missable: no — the hunt is a repeatable activity prompt. Tip: bring a scoped weapon and patience; a unique animal is a tracking job first and a shot second.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: What: finish 3 complete collectible card sets. How: find cards scattered across Leonida and assemble three full sets; a set only counts when every card in it is found. Missable: no — cards stay where they are until collected. Tip: work one set at a time and note which cards you hold in the notes field here, so you never re-hunt a card you already own.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: What: use WAiNK at 100 different locations — the second-biggest counted grind after stunts. How: open the WAiNK app at each spot and check in; the count climbs one location at a time, so make it a habit on every trip, not a single marathon. Missable: no — locations never expire. Tip: fold WAiNK stops into the meditation-spot and vehicle-discovery routes; one drive can feed three counters at once.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: What: complete 50 challenges of any kind. How: take on the game's challenge list (driving, combat, exploration and more) and tick off 50; any mix counts. Missable: no — challenges are open-ended free-roam goals. Tip: this pairs with everything in stage 4 — stunts, races and range medals all feed the challenge count while you chase their own trophies.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you in free roam or a shared story window — plan it before the endgame.
trophies.guide: What: with your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. How: bring your partner along, raise heat to four stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Missable: watch — it needs the partner present, so do it while partner free-roam is available, not after the story closes those windows. Tip: a fast car and a quiet hiding spot beat a gunfight — losing the cops is the trophy, not fighting them.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you and three robberies in a row with heat held — plan it before the endgame.
trophies.guide: What: with your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — meaning keep the heat on through all three. How: hit three shops back to back with your partner, moving fast between them and keeping the wanted level alive the whole run. Missable: watch — it needs the partner and a clean three-in-a-row, so attempt it while partner windows are open. Tip: plan the route first — three close shops, a getaway car parked ready, and no detours.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: What: discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. How: drive, ride and find new vehicles — each new one you encounter counts toward the 100. Missable: no — vehicles keep appearing in free roam. Tip: vary where you drive (city streets, highways, countryside, the beach) — different areas hide different vehicles, and the count grows fastest when you explore.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: What: drop 5 enemies inside one single Combat Focus. How: wait for a moment with five or more enemies grouped up, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Missable: no — Combat Focus can be used again in any fight. Tip: do not waste it on two stragglers — set it up where enemies cluster, then fire once the group is in view.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_reason: The description points at a one-off departure inside the VCIA mission window — do it when the chance appears, it may not come back.
trophies.guide: What: leave VCIA airport on your own schedule, not the one the mission planned. How: during the VCIA mission window, break away and make your own unscheduled departure from the airport instead of following the scripted exit. Missable: likely — this is the one trophy the description ties to a specific place and a specific moment, so do it the first time you are at VCIA with the chance open. Tip: pair it with Hi-Jacked (the VCIA Takedown mission) and attempt the departure while you are already inside.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: What: the Rhino tank moment — the description is a joke about how hot it gets inside one. How: get into a Rhino tank and play with it until the trophy pops; the description's wording suggests the feat is about using the Rhino itself, not a counted grind. Missable: no — Rhinos can be found again in free roam. Tip: tanks draw heavy wanted attention, so pick an open area and enjoy the chaos rather than fighting it.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: What: rob a jewelry store clean without ever being detected. How: case the store, move quietly, take the goods and leave before any alarm or witness spots you — detection fails the attempt, so patience beats speed. Missable: no — jewelry stores can be robbed again. Tip: go in quiet and unarmed-looking if you can; the trophy is about never being seen, not about the getaway.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: What: rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. How: hit five different bank vaults, getting out clean each time — the count needs escapes, so a robbery that ends in cuffs or worse does not count. Missable: no — vaults can be attempted repeatedly. Tip: plan each escape route before you go in, and space the five hits out — one clean vault at a time beats five rushed ones.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: What: rob one armored truck and get away. How: find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cargo and escape before the response arrives. Missable: no — armored trucks keep running their routes. Tip: pick a quiet stretch of road with a fast getaway car nearby; the robbery is quick, the escape is the trophy.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: What: explore every corner of Leonida — the whole map, not just the cities. How: drive, fly and sail into every region until the map is filled in; the trophy pops when no unexplored area remains. Missable: no — the map waits for you in free roam. Tip: this is the natural partner for Whip It Good and You WAiNKer! — explore with the checklist open and every mile feeds three trophies.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: What: rob one illegal operation from every gang in Leonida. How: find each gang's illegal operation, hit it, and move on to the next gang — the trophy needs one per gang, so coverage matters more than repetition. Missable: no — gang operations stay hittable in free roam. Tip: keep a list in the notes field of which gangs you have hit, so the last one is not a guessing game.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missable_reason: A quiet story-beat moment — visit Ocean Beach when the story allows it.
trophies.guide: What: sit down with a cocktail and the view on Ocean Beach. How: head to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and order and enjoy a cocktail there. Missable: watch — the description reads like a story-beat moment, so take it when the story brings you near the beach rather than assuming it waits forever. Tip: the easiest trophy in the set if you catch it at the right moment — slow down and enjoy it.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_reason: A set-piece smash during a story beat — it happens inside a mission, not in free roam.
trophies.guide: What: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style — through the glass, in a car, the way the series has always done it. How: during the story beat that puts you in the showroom, drive out through the front instead of using the door. Missable: likely — a set-piece moment tied to a story beat, so take the smash when the scene offers it; a polite exit may not come back. Tip: if the scene gives you a car and a window, the game is telling you what to do.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: What: a proper follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. How: go bowling at the alley and bowl with a full follow-through — the trophy is about the delivery, so commit to the throw rather than rushing it. Missable: no — the alley stays open for another game. Tip: this is the gentle half of the bowling pair; Ten Pin is the loud one, this one is the careful one.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner beside you in a shared window — plan it before the endgame.
trophies.guide: What: a partnership feat with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, but the partner tag gives the shape of it. How: do something big together with your partner in a way the crowd would notice; the wording points at a shared, showy moment rather than a quiet one. Missable: watch — partner feats belong to shared windows, so attempt it while your partner is available, not after the story. Tip: keep this on the stage-5 list with Hot Together and Retail Therapy and clear all three in one partner session.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Choice-gated: the description is about choices made, so the moment passes once you choose.
trophies.guide: What: make a choice that matters — the description is only 'Choices made (for better or worse)', which means the trophy is about deciding, not about which way you decide. How: when the story offers a real choice, make it and live with it; the trophy pops on the decision. Missable: likely — a choice, once made, cannot be unmade in that playthrough, so if a decision point looks weighty, treat it as this trophy and save first if the game allows it. Tip: this is the top of the missable watch list for a reason — never rush a story choice.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_reason: A fail-state trophy — engineer the first failure deliberately; a clean first try may lock it out.
trophies.guide: What: succeed on the second try — the description says 'Second time's the charm', which reads like a fail-state trophy: fail once, then win. How: pick the moment the description points at, fail it deliberately the first time, then complete it on the retry. Missable: watch — if you nail it first try, the second-try condition may never come back, so plan the failure before you attempt it clean. Tip: this is the only trophy where losing on purpose is the strategy — save first, fail once, then win.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Series conventions from GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy design

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_reason: A one-off event the description refuses to explain — easy to walk past and never see again.
trophies.guide: What: witness something strange — the description ('What the hell just happened?') is the game's way of saying this is a one-off oddity, not a checklist item. How: explore Leonida's weird corners and pay attention to events that feel out of place; when something odd happens, stay with it until it resolves. Missable: likely — one-off events do not repeat, so a strange moment walked past is a strange moment lost. Tip: if something feels wrong in a good way, stop driving and watch — this trophy rewards curiosity.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
Roadmap ordering derived from the official trophy descriptions

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: What: bowl people over with a melee drive-by — the loud half of the bowling pair. How: from a moving vehicle, use a melee attack to knock people down like pins. Missable: no — drive-bys can be attempted anywhere in free roam. Tip: find a crowded, slow-speed area and line the shot up like a bowling lane; speed matters less than the angle.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: What: launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. How: collect Marked Bills (they come from the crime side of the game) and wash them through your contacts, a little at a time, until the $250,000 total is reached. Missable: no — the total only climbs. Tip: start laundering early and keep it ticking alongside the money trophies — it pairs naturally with Treat Yo Self's $100,000 of spending.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: What: spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. How: buy things — clothes, weapons, cars, upgrades — and the total climbs with every purchase in any shop. Missable: no — spending is always available. Tip: spend on things the other trophies need (garages for Little Boxes, gear for the range) and the $100,000 spends itself; do not waste it on throwaway purchases.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: What: buy every garage property in Leonida. How: visit each garage for sale, save up, and buy them one by one until none remain unowned. Missable: no — properties stay for sale in free roam. Tip: garages also count toward Treat Yo Self's spending total, so buy them before splurging elsewhere — and they give your 100 discovered vehicles somewhere to live.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: What: register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. How: open the Scooter Bros app with a vehicle and register it; repeat with nine more different vehicles. Missable: no — registration stays open in free roam. Tip: register the interesting vehicles you find while hunting Whip It Good's 100 — the two trophies share the same road trips.
sources: Official PlayStation 5 trophy list (Exophase / PSNProfiles mirror)
